nodes.title: 制作输出 · 反向物理时间溯源 (-5秒)

metadata.prompt: Reconstruct the physically logical moment that occurred exactly 5 seconds before the supplied image. Reverse cause and effect to show what led to this situation: the preceding stance or approach that began the current action, the undisturbed state before an impact or movement, the original position of objects before being moved, and the anticipation in character posture. Preserve the exact identity, facial features, hairstyle, clothing, body proportions, materials, color grading and art style of the supplied image. Maintain backward continuity of character appearance, environment and lighting. Do not add text, captions, watermarks, logos or frame borders.

nodes.title: 制作说明 · 反向物理时间溯源 (-5秒)

metadata.content:
模板说明：反向物理时间溯源 (-5秒)
请先在“上传原图”节点导入对应原始图片，再使用“制作输出”节点。
这是可复制的原生制作模板，不是已生成的成片案例；当前图片状态为未生成，也没有封面、模型、渠道或费用配置。
原始比例：源码未提供固定比例；复制后请先选择与原图对应的画幅，本模板不自动推断或保持比例，不预设 size
来源文件：03_画板视觉矩阵提示词/原生画板12组视觉矩阵提示词源码.md
来源 SHA256：f68de06d35341ee3c4460e29e14ac41e43318653fa6b33c8b371d21c3e2edba2
原始片段（仅作可追溯内容，不执行）：
```javascript
{
  scene: "frame-prediction-minus-5s",
  prompt: [
    "Reconstruct the physically logical moment that occurred exactly 5 seconds before the supplied image.",
    "Reverse cause and effect to show what led to this situation: the preceding stance or approach that began the current action, the undisturbed state before an impact or movement, the original position of objects before being moved, and the anticipation in character posture.",
    qa,
    "Maintain backward continuity of character appearance, environment and lighting.",
    Xa
  ].join(" ")
}
```
